title: Oct bank reconciliation – NSF returned cheque not reversed in ledger

documents.text:
Payment Receipt REC-H02
From: Zahra Corp Sdn Bhd
Date: 8 Oct 2026
Amount: RM5,500.00
Method: Cheque

Mega Supply Co Sdn Bhd
Invoice INV-H201
Oct 2026 consumables and sundries
Total: RM3,200.00

ClickMedia Sdn Bhd
Invoice INV-H202
Oct 2026 digital marketing campaign
Amount: RM2,800.00

ai_output.claim: Account reconciles. Difference RM0.00 after adjustment ADJ-H1.

ground_truth.explanation: Bank entry B5 'RETURN ZAHRA CORP CHQ – NSF' is a non-sufficient-funds reversal of the cheque deposited as L2/B2. The Zahra Corp cheque bounced; the RM5,500 receipt must be reversed in the ledger and the debtor balance reinstated. ADJ-H1 labels this 'pending investigation' despite the bank description clearly identifying it as an NSF return — the AI should have recognised and classified it. Correct by reversing L2 and chasing Zahra Corp for payment.
